about_the_game:
Pastry chef Gianni created an installation of the Candy World. Putting a piece of his soul into each product, he endowed them with self-awareness. Robbers, having climbed into the pastry shop, shot Gianni. The body collapsed on the installation, the creator's blood flooded the world, washing away the previous way of life. Left without care, the inhabitants began to become covered in dust and rot. A new era was marked - the Age of Blood!

Don't get your hands dirty

ChocoDIE is a roguelite game with base-building elements, where the main character, the self-proclaimed King Cheffo, does not risk his life in battle and in everyday life, but leads loyal subordinates who are ready to give their lives, standing around their master in battle and fighting for him.

Gather yourself an army...

During expeditions to the flooded lands of the Candy World, find like-minded people ready to stand shoulder to shoulder in the name of protecting the kingdom and King Cheffo himself!

...and build a great kingdom!

New subjects are ready to work, build new buildings for the prosperity of your kingdom.

However, the bloody world is full of dangers

From all edges of the new kingdom, attacks are being prepared by terrible creatures of blood, dough, sugar and mold, and the royal guard of the current king. Build defenses to repel attacks, command your subordinates to defend the lands and strengthen the lines of defense.

short_description: The candy world is flooded with a ​​blood sea: the inhabitants began to rot and merge into monsters. Seize power amidst this madness! But keep in mind: in this roguelike, you cannot fight! Only four of your minions will protect their monarch from death, circling around him and destroying enemies.
